Pulled latest `main` into `codex/label-git-pull-history`, now at `555af48`. PR #38 is merged; working tree is clean.

I’d give the two summaries different purposes:

| | Turn summary | Transcript summary |
|---|---|---|
| Question | What happened in this turn? | How did this task develop? |
| Display | Short title in the history list, expandable detail | Session overview with links to relevant turns |
| Contents | Request, changes, verification, unresolved issues | Goal, decisions, changes of direction, outcome, remaining work |
| Example | “Added pull labels; regression checks passed” | “Investigated confusing history entries, chose reflog evidence, implemented attribution, opened PR” |

**For turn summaries**, feed a small model the user request, final response, recorded changes, and relevant test results. Keep the title around 8–12 words. Verify outcome claims against tool results so “planned to fix” never becomes “fixed.” Discussion-only turns should also be eligible.

**For transcript summaries**, start with a short overview and a few key decisions linked to their original messages. For long sessions, summarize bounded chunks, then combine them. Preserve user corrections and abandoned approaches when they explain the final decision.

**A smaller model makes sense.** I’d benchmark one model for both before adding routing between models. OpenAI currently recommends GPT-5.6 Luna for new speed- and cost-sensitive workloads. [Official model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5-nano)

Following ponytail, I’d start with:

- Generate on demand using a proposed `sun summarize` command.
- Cache locally so opening `sun viz` stays instant.
- Reuse Sun’s existing transcript parsers and model-command mechanism.
- Keep summaries separate from recorded history, with source links and a “generated summary” label.
- Make provider submission explicit; local transcript storage alone should not enable automatic model calls.

My first version would be **turn titles plus an on-demand session overview**. Automatic generation after each turn can follow once quality and cost look good.
